permitted.answer: Yes, as a committal of ashes in a biodegradable container, subject to the Captain's approval.

documentedOrIndividualApproval.answer: Documented policy, but each committal requires approval from the Captain in advance of the voyage.

leadTime.answer: At least 90 days prior to sailing.

contactDepartment.answer: Customer Contact Centre (UK page; also rendered as Customer Service Department).

writtenApplication.answer: Not published as a form; booked as a Committal of Ashes Package with full payment at booking.

deathOrCremationCertificate.answer: Cremation certificate must be brought on board. Death certificate not mentioned.

containerRequirements.answer: Ashes must be in a biodegradable container; US page (paraphrase) adds proof that the container is biodegradable and carriage in hand luggage.

scatterOrReleaseUrn.answer: Release in the urn: 'The ashes will not be scattered but committed to the sea in a biodegradable container.'

designatedArea.answer: An outside area, typically a lower deck.

crewParticipation.answer: The Captain or a Senior Officer accompanies the family and will say a prayer if requested.

fees.answer: A paid Committal of Ashes Package exists (full payment at booking); price not seen.

weatherItineraryLimits.answer: Itinerary/location restrictions and Captain's discretion apply; US page (paraphrase) excludes Norwegian fjords and Alaska state waters and notes weather limits.

gpsCoordinates.answer: Forum anecdote only: a certificate with coordinates was received.

certificateConfirmation.answer: Not officially published; forum anecdote reports a Captain-signed certificate.

differsByVesselItinerary.answer: Yes, itinerary/location restrictions apply (e.g. fjords, Alaska state waters per US page paraphrase).
